intent: To demonstrate that Ikea's legal structure effectively makes it one of the world's largest charitable foundations.

requirements.question: Must the video state/show Ikea as third in the ranking, or is it enough to show Ikea as merely one of the largest?
Must the animation show Ikea's own value/endpoint, or can it omit it and only show rank/gap?
Must the video quantify Ikea as roughly 30% smaller than Gates, or is a visual gap enough?

units.claim: Stichting Ingka (Ikea's foundation) is third largest among the four entities shown: Bill & Melinda Gates 51.6 > Novo Nordisk 49.1 > Stichting Ingka 36.0 > Wellcome Trust 32.9.
accept: Stichting Ingka ranks third, behind the Gates Foundation and Novo Nordisk and ahead of Wellcome Trust.
The chart order is Gates 51.6, Novo Nordisk 49.1, Stichting Ingka 36.0, Wellcome Trust 32.9.
Ikea is the third-largest foundation in this comparison.
units.evidence: Bars or labels must show Stichting Ingka in third position, with two larger values above it and one smaller value below it.

units.claim: Stichting Ingka's charted value is 36.000, with relative_value 0.6000.
accept: Stichting Ingka (Ikea) has a value of 36.0 and relative value 0.6000.
Ikea's foundation endpoint is 36.0 on the chart.
The Stichting Ingka bar ends at 36.0, or 0.60 on the relative scale.
units.evidence: Stichting Ingka's bar/endpoint must be labeled 36.0 or 0.6000 relative.

units.claim: Ikea/Stichting Ingka is about 30% smaller than the Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation.

basis.note: Gates value used as comparison denominator
Gates relative value for alternate formula
Ikea relative value for alternate formula

accept: Ikea is about 30% smaller than the Gates Foundation.
Ikea/Stichting Ingka is about 70% of the Gates Foundation's value (36.0 vs 51.6).
The Gates-to-Ikea gap is 15.6, equal to about 30.2% of Gates's 51.6.
Using relative values, 0.6000 is about 30.2% below 0.8600.
units.evidence: The visual must compare Gates and Ikea and show or label the roughly 30% smaller gap, not just their absolute bars.

optional_valid: Show all four entity names and absolute values as bar labels: Gates 51.6, Novo Nordisk 49.1, Stichting Ingka 36.0, Wellcome Trust 32.9.
Display the relative_value scores 0.8600, 0.8183, 0.6000, and 0.5483 alongside the bars.
Animate the 15.6 gap between Gates and Stichting Ingka.
Highlight Wellcome Trust as the smallest bar at 32.9.

g0_data_completeness.selection: all role=bar data rows; annotation rows excluded
